measurement_note: Size is n for a legal perfect tree with mixed costs. Bottom-up reuse processes each node once, while recomputing child-to-leaf maxima independently for every parent revisits each node once per ancestor and takes O(n log n). All tiers are legal and the slower implementation can finish without a safety cap.
